decisions.reason: Although the multi-model product line involved investment, its distance from the firm's core and limited public visibility mean escalation is only moderate, so while persistence is likely, withdrawal risk remains elevated.
Its dedicated webpage and clear fit with the established offer reflect strong public commitment and strategic centrality, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.

As a core, multi-model industrial line with a dedicated webpage, it combines high sunk investment, public visibility, and centrality, leading to very strong escalation and minimal withdrawal probability.

The product is close to the established offer and has a dedicated page, but it is a single model launched later, so investment and visibility are somewhat lower than for multi-model lines, yielding a moderate but still low withdrawal risk.
As a premium, multi-model pendant line close to the core with its own page, it has high sunk investment and public commitment, making the firm likely to persist strongly.
